plan.notes: Source: Palomar College Program Pathways Mapper (official), Astronomy Certificate of Achievement Program pathway map, https://programmap.palomar.edu/pathway/astronomy-to-career/?pt=map&year=2026, retrieved 2026-10-06. Palomar publishes empty trailing term(s) [5] with no courses; omitted as data artifacts (sequence renumbered). Palomar publishes the program total as a range (35–37 units); Choice/variable-unit groups transcribed at the minimum-unit option (choice:true; official ranges in choice_note). total_credits (35) is the exact sum of the minimum-unit pathway. All AA/AS/AA-T/AS-T degrees require 60 units per Palomar; maps represent one possible pathway — see a counselor for a personalized plan.
